---
title: "Mycelium"
---

lucid-writer works without Mycelium. In a [Mycelium](https://github.com/arjunrajlaboratory/mycelium) repository, it writes from verified provenance and leaves every deterministic check to mycelium-extra. It detects such a repository by `.living/` and `.mycelium/` together.

## Source of truth

The skill ranks what is on disk:

1. `<analysis>/provenance/`: `verify-<hash>.md` holds the claims verdicts (numbers); `outputs-<hash>.tsv` records which run wrote each file (figures). This counts as verified only when the hash is listed in `PROVENANCE.md` and `/mycelium-extra:verify` ran in the current session.
2. `<analysis>/outputs/numbers.json` and `<!-- claims -->` blocks: registered values whose producer is not established.
3. `.living/findings/` entries: project notes, never evidence for an observed claim.
4. Existing manuscript prose.

A lower tier never silently replaces prose: a disagreement is flagged for the author. Analysis files are read-only; the manuscript's own `<!-- claims -->` block is the skill's to write.

## Who checks what

| Check | Owner |
|---|---|
| a number in prose matches an output cell, one call per plan hash | `/mycelium-extra:verify` `report` |
| figure freshness after inputs change | `/mycelium-extra:verify` `stale` |
| the declared figure contract (`config/manuscript_checks.json`) | `/mycelium-extra:manuscript-audit` |
| a DOI, PMID or arXiv ID exists | `/mycelium-extra:verify` `report --resolve-citations` |
| a citation supports the exact claim; inference ceiling; causal and scope language | lucid-writer |
| cross-artifact consistency, figure–text flags, placeholders | lucid-writer preflight and `lint.py` |

lucid-writer calls the mycelium-extra checks through their own skills and reads the results. The preflight subagent is read-only: it accepts a result only when the main agent reports running it in the session, and maps a `block` status to a release blocker.

Claim-ledger rows use the same cell grammar as a verify claims block, so a ledger row becomes a claims line by adding its value: `<value> | <file> <column> [<row>]`.

## Convention pack

To offer lucid-writer as a report style in `/mycelium:report`, install its convention pack into the Mycelium repository:

```bash
python3 "$(cat .mycelium/plugin-root)/skills/core/scripts/install_convention.py" \
  --name lucid-writer --network-dir /path/to/lucid-writer/network/conventions
```

The router still follows `report-generator` (LaTeX PDF) by default and lists other installed packs as choices. `/mycelium-extra:analysis-report` keeps Quarto analysis reports; the lucid-writer pack covers manuscripts. Rerun the install after upgrading, because the pack's `version:` tracks the skill's.

The pack is three files in [`network/conventions/lucid-writer/`](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-writer/tree/main/network/conventions/lucid-writer): the pack manifest, the routing steps, and a QC checklist.
